detail.title: Provisional Foundations of WAKE Durable Record
detail.summary: WAKE models operational state through a deterministic replay of accepted events, ensuring that current state is never cached but derived from an authoritative, append-only SQLite log. Governance acts as the sole validator for proposals, preventing invalid states from entering the durable chain.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate governance and record store roles in operational state modeling.

children.title: Cycle 24 · WAKE Architectural Synthesis: Proposal vs. Governance

detail.title: WAKE Architectural Synthesis: Proposal vs. Governance
detail.summary: WAKE achieves state integrity by strictly separating model proposals from governance-validated state transitions within an append-only event record. The operational state is not cached but reconstructed via replay, ensuring that invalid proposals remain outside the durable history.
